reason: The pinned guide, hash, quotes, request and capture boundaries, and reciprocal placement check out. The recurring takeaway omits a material eligibility gate from the Klarna overview it invokes: Adyen directs merchants to contact Support before offering recurring payments (raw/adyen/docs/payment-methods/klarna/2026-09-15.md:38). A reader asking whether token creation alone permits recurring Klarna could receive a misleading answer.
required_changes: In the recurring takeaway and Q2 answer, state that Adyen's Klarna overview tells merchants to contact Support before offering recurring payments. Retain the overview's Pay over time limit to long-term subscriptions and its exclusion of monthly subscriptions and one-off on-demand tokenized purchases; keep token mechanics tied to this Web Drop-in guide. Preserve the related overview route when promoted.
